title: AMLO Warns of the Rise of Neofascism: “It’s Not the Right, nor the Far Right”
author: SinEmbargo Staff
content:
_This article by[SinEmbargo
Staff](https://www.sinembargo.mx/author/redaccion/) originally appeared in the
[September 30, 2026 edition of
SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4879587/amlo-regresa-en-video-y-anuncia-
libro-pueblo-la-sola-palabra-causa-molestia/), a Mexican independent digital
news outlet._

_The former president dedicated his new book to Claudia Sheinbaum, whom he
considered the best President in the world._

**Mexico City, September 30 (SinEmbargo).—** Former president **Andrés Manuel
López Obrador** (AMLO) returned to the public stage today in a video, from his
La Chingada ranch, and spoke about History; he recalled the transformations
Mexico has lived through and harshly criticized the **six presidents of
neoliberalism** and the Mexican **media**.

The popular former Mexican president warned, in his message on Facebook and
YouTube, that the right did not evolve toward the **far right** but toward
**fascism** :

> It's not the right, it's not the far right; it's neofascism.
>
> Andrés Manuel López Obrador

AMLO has a new book: it's called **_Pueblo_**.

López Obrador was critical of the 36 years of neoliberalism. He said that
Ernesto Zedillo, whom he called "cynical," promised that Fobaproa (the 1990s
bank bailout fund) would cost 180 billion dollars, but so far it has cost, in
interest alone, 1.6 trillion. And 1.2 trillion dollars are still left to pay,
he recalled.

AMLO's reappearance comes as this September marks 20 years since the
consummation of the 2006 electoral fraud, and as President Claudia Sheinbaum
completes two years since taking office as head of the federal Executive. It
also comes on the same day that former president Felipe Calderón reappeared in
Mexico (he lives in Spain) at a far-right forum.

> Amigas y amigos:  
>  
> En esta ocasión les presento mi nuevo libro: Pueblo. El anterior, Grandeza,

> valores y espiritualidad. A este último, originalmente había pensado ponerle
> Gloria, para contar la también… <https://t.co/09RXNwyl9K>
>
